            if digit == 0:
                break  # Loop terminates when current_number is 0
            current_number -= 1
            break  # increment the digit to the right for the next loop
            current_number += 1
            
        # Perform the iteration: append the digit to the result string
        reversed_number = current_number + digit
        print(f"--- Reversal of {current_number} ---")
        return reversed_number

        # Handle negative numbers by rounding if necessary

            return reversed_number

            # Use str() to print the reversed version
            reversed_number = str(reversed_number)
            print(f"--- Reversal of {current_number} ---")
            return reversed_number
